limitations: MI stream records are untagged; host association with the request remains necessary. Completion tokens do not authenticate the host or stream.
Only the selected elapsed-time line and matching completion are parsed, not other monitor diagnostics.
Tokens may repeat across recreated sessions. GDB transport and before/after inspection stability remain host-owned.
Real fault controls precede arming; malformed final input and shared-deadline timeout are tested with real Windows pipes.
No new debugger operations, MCU capabilities, commit or remote publication.
